organizationHelp: Organizations keep tasks, settings, and access separate. Create one when you are ready; agents and model connections can be configured later from the dashboard.
agentHelp: Agent setup is optional. You can return to the dashboard at any time and configure an agent when you are ready.
noAgents: No agents yet. You can explore this organization and configure an agent whenever you are ready.
createdPending: The organization was created, but its dashboard is not ready in this session. Retry opening it, or cancel and return to the main page. Retrying will not create another organization.
